verdict: The batch page of the finished S3.8 batch draws no frame over 100 ms, alone or under the runner load, before and after, so no Studio cause is named and no Studio file is changed (step 5 rule).
whyOutsideThePage: S3.8 drew 312,414 frames in 5,401 s (57.8 a second); this PC drew 180 a second in every window here, so the S3.8 display cadence differed.
S3.8 max frame 1,084 ms with the longest task 111 ms: its slow frames were not one script; here every long frame has under 1 ms of main-thread work.

Since the settled batch draws none, the S3.8 slow frames came while the drop ran (17 uploads through the page, live changes, processing at up to 100 % CPU); its single whole-drop capture gives no timeline to name them.
The cold first load drew one 110 ms frame (longest task 50 ms) before the windows; a traced reload drew none.
